Markets.title: US stocks: US market ends down as oil prices, Treasury yields rise
Markets.summary: US stocks closed lower due to disappointing performances from Alphabet and Amazon, alongside rising Treasury yields and oil prices. Meanwhile, strong US business activity sparked speculation about potential economic impacts.

Markets.title: US diesel futures fall on report of export ban plan; White House calls it fake news
Markets.summary: US diesel futures dropped after reports of a potential 90-day export ban, though the White House dismissed the rumor as fake news. Energy Secretary Chris Wright questioned whether the ban would effectively lower rising fuel prices driven by supply cuts from Russia and Saudi Arabia.

Markets.title: Melania Trump rings New York Stock Exchange opening bell to launch new women's initiative Imperia
Markets.summary: On Wednesday, Melania Trump rang the New York Stock Exchange opening bell to launch her new women's empowerment initiative, Imperia. During the event, she highlighted women's economic impact and discussed global issues such as war-separated children.

Markets.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr signals more rate hikes needed to tame inflation
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr stated that more interest rate hikes are needed because inflation remains above the 2% target. This viewpoint differs from the Fed Chairman, who has not yet provided guidance on future rates.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities closed higher on Wednesday, driven by falling crude prices, stronger domestic growth signals, and broad-based gains in metals and banking stocks. The Sensex rose 299 points and the Nifty gained 118 points, with broader markets outperforming the main indices.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Vijaya Diagnostic among 3 stock recommendations for Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities closed higher due to a focus on domestic growth despite ongoing geopolitical and crude oil risks. An expert has recommended Vijaya Diagnostic and two other stocks based on bullish trends and breakout signals.

Geo-Political.title: AI superpower ambitions take centre stage as Trump and Xi meet
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump and Chinese President Xi met to discuss artificial intelligence supremacy. Both nations are competing for dominance in the field while aiming to maintain human control over the technology.

Geo-Political.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
Geo-Political.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated at the United Nations that Iran will never submit to the United States. This defiant response follows a threat from the U.S. president to annihilate Iran if a peace agreement is not reached soon.

Geo-Political.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
Geo-Political.summary: Ethiopia and Tigray have accused each other of launching new military offensives, raising fears of a renewed war. This escalation follows reports of recent drone strikes and the local authorities reportedly seizing airports in Tigray.

Geo-Political.title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction
Geo-Political.summary: Trump's Board of Peace has announced a $2.45 billion plan to begin the reconstruction of Gaza. The funding figure was revealed during a board meeting held on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

Geo-Political.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
Geo-Political.summary: An 87-year-old woman named Maricarmen was evicted from her Madrid apartment after failing to pay the increased rent demanded by the firm that recently bought the building. This dramatic event underscores the severe housing shortage in Spain.

Geo-Political.title: UK survivor of Canadian poison seller says he exploited her despair
Geo-Political.summary: Elisabeth Belien told Kenneth Law's sentencing hearing that she was 23 years old when she consumed the poison he sold. She stated that Law exploited her despair.

Data & Insights.title: Centre cuts import duty on edible oils to curb price rise
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has reduced import duties on edible oils to control rising prices. This reduction aims to lower cooking oil import costs and potentially relieve consumers if supply chain savings are passed down.

Data & Insights.title: PM’s principal secretary flags risks from trade barriers, volatile capital
Data & Insights.summary: India's principal secretary Pramod Kumar Mishra warned that the country cannot depend on favorable global conditions despite its economic stability and growth. He specifically highlighted potential risks from trade barriers and volatile capital flows.

Data & Insights.title: Rupee has a fair case to appreciate: RBI DG Poonam Gupta
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta states that the rupee's recent depreciation is likely temporary. She attributes this view to India's strong underlying balance of payments.

Data & Insights.title: Flash PMI: Business activity hits three-month high in September on robust manufacturing demand
Data & Insights.summary: Middle East tensions prompted companies to build record inventory buffers in September, pushing business activity to a three-month high. Additionally, rising output prices reflected renewed efforts by businesses to safeguard their profit margins.

Data & Insights.title: After Moody's, now S&P and Fitch raise their India growth forecasts
Data & Insights.summary: Following Moody's, S&P and Fitch have increased their economic growth forecasts for India. The rating agencies attribute this upward revision to strong growth, alongside expected interest rate hikes driven by high inflation and the conflict in West Asia.

Data & Insights.title: India tops EMs again in August, but market risks persist
Data & Insights.summary: India ranked first in Mint’s Emerging Markets Tracker for August due to strong GDP growth, robust exports, and solid import cover. However, an imminent rate-hike cycle and geopolitical risks threaten future market stability.

India.title: 5 Seconds, 5 Bullets: Men On Bike Shoot At Ex-Councillor In Patna Colony
India.summary: Two men on a motorcycle shot Anil Yadav, the husband of a Patna ward councillor, five times in a local colony. Yadav sustained four to five bullet injuries in his hands, lower abdomen, and legs.

India.title: CCTV Shows Moment When IIT Student Was Stopped During Exam, Pulled Aside
India.summary: CCTV footage from IIT Bombay shows an invigilator stopping and pulling a student aside from his front-row seat during an exam. The specific reason for the intervention is not detailed in the available text.

India.title: High Court Acquits UP Woman Convicted Of Killing Her 3 Children
India.summary: A high court acquitted a Uttar Pradesh woman and her alleged partner of murdering her three children, setting aside their previous conviction and sentences. The bench consisting of Justices Siddhartha Varma and Jai Krishna Upadhyay delivered the ruling on Tuesday in favor of Priyanka and Ashish.

India.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Can Slow Down, No One's Pointing Gun: Sridhar Vembu To NDTV
India.summary: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu stated that leading AI companies like OpenAI and Anthropic do not need to rush their development. Meanwhile, his Chennai-based software firm celebrated its 30th anniversary by launching Zia Chat, an AI tool that integrates business data and workflows.

India.title: Chargesheet Filed In Ram Temple Donation Theft Case, Trustees Not Named
India.summary: Police filed a chargesheet against two individuals, Subhash Srivastava and Ramashankar Yadav, in the Ram temple donation theft case without naming the temple trustees. The bail applications for both accused are scheduled to be heard on Thursday.

India.title: Central Agency Search In Mohali Is Fresh Political Flashpoint In Punjab
India.summary: On Tuesday, Enforcement Directorate teams began searching official records, examining computer systems, and questioning staff members in Mohali. This operation has sparked a fresh political flashpoint in Punjab.

General.title: Blood tests find high level of cancer-causing forever chemical in residents near factory
General.summary: Blood tests revealed high levels of cancer-causing "forever chemicals" in residents living near a major chemical factory in Lancashire. These individuals have been warned they could face serious health risks due to the contamination.

General.title: UK military jamming other nations' satellites to defend itself, BBC told
General.summary: The head of the RAF stated that the UK military jams other nations' satellites to defend itself against unprecedented space threats. This disclosure coincides with the creation of a new unit dedicated to protecting Britain's satellite infrastructure.

General.title: Watch: Moment pilots eject as RAF jet crashes in Anglesey
General.summary: Two pilots safely ejected from a Royal Air Force jet before it crashed in Anglesey. Both pilots sustained minor injuries in the incident.

General.title: Home secretary says undetected migrant landings 'unacceptable'
General.summary: The arrivals of two unescorted migrant boats mark the first uncontrolled landings recorded in the UK since 2025.

General.title: Burnham brands ban on football fans drinking alcohol in stands as 'discrimination'
General.summary: Andy Burnham has criticized the 1985 ban on football fans drinking alcohol in stadium stands as discrimination. The prime minister opposes the current law and believes a case exists for its removal.
